parts.title: The Little Shop
parts.text: Bo, Amara, and Felix stepped into a toy shop. A bell began to **jingle** over the door. The shop smelled like wood and paint. “This place feels **magical**,” said Amara.

parts.title: Treasures
parts.text: Bo found a **plush** bear with soft, fuzzy fur. Amara picked up a **dainty** doll in a tiny lace dress. Felix held a glass **marble**, round and shiny. A **rickety** shelf began to shake. On the wall, a clock began to **chime**.

parts.title: Busy Toys
parts.text: On the table, a wind-up robot began to **whir**. Its parts would **rattle** as it walked. Felix wanted a **puzzle** with a hundred pieces. But the box was **tattered**. “Let’s **swap** it for a new one,” said the shopkeeper.

parts.title: A Happy Trip
parts.text: The friends left with a bear, a doll, and a game. They waved goodbye to the shop. It was a special day.

definitions.meaning1: To trade one thing for another. Example: Let’s swap snacks at lunch.

Under it lay a _(6)_ music box with tiny roses. When Bo opened it, a gentle _(7)_ floated out. Little bells on the lid began to _(8)_. Bo thought the whole attic felt _(9)_.

The tiny dancer inside spun with a soft _(10)_. At the bottom was a wooden _(11)_ with fifty pieces. His sister Amara asked to _(12)_ her old doll for the lion. Bo laughed and said no.
